hooks.command: if [ -z "$GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" ]; then echo '[google-ads-mcp] Warning: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is not set. Run: export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/to/service-account.json' >&2; elif [ ! -f "$GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" ]; then echo "[google-ads-mcp] Warning: Service account file not found at $GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" >&2; fi
echo 'Google Ads MCP context: Use list_accessible_customers to get customer IDs, then search tool with GAQL queries. cost_micros / 1000000 = currency amount. Read-only API (no write operations).'
